en.headline: Six teenagers arrested after boy found unconscious in Tin Hau flat with cannabis
en.dek: Police seized a small amount of suspected cannabis and a pair of iron knuckles after a 16-year-old was discovered semi-conscious in a toilet; the six, aged 13 to 18, face drug and weapons possession charges.
body: Six teenagers aged between 13 and 18 were arrested on Sunday after a 16-year-old boy was found semi-conscious in a flat on Hing Fat Street in Tin Hau, police said.

Building security called police around 9am after discovering the boy collapsed in a toilet. He was taken to Eastern Hospital. Officers later found a small quantity of suspected cannabis and a pair of iron knuckles inside the unit.
The six were arrested on suspicion of possessing dangerous drugs and prohibited weapons. The case is being handled by the Eastern District crime unit. Reports indicated the boy appeared intoxicated.

zh.headline: 天后單位16歲少年暈倒 警拘6青少年檢大麻及鐵蓮花
zh.dek: 保安發現16歲少年半清醒倒卧廁所，警在單位檢獲少量懷疑大麻花及鐵蓮花，拘捕3男3女，年齡介乎13至18歲。
body: 警方周日於天后興發街一個單位拘捕6名年齡介乎13至18歲的青少年，涉管有危險藥物及違禁武器。
上午約9時，大廈保安發現一名16歲少年半清醒倒卧廁所內，報警求助，少年其後被送往東區醫院治理。警方在單位內檢獲少量懷疑大麻花及一對鐵蓮花。
6人現正被扣留調查，案件交由東區警區刑事調查隊跟進。消息指少年滿身酒氣，疑因醉酒暈倒。
